bottom_line: The ratings still point the right way for power, grid and cooling, but tonight is a poor entry: futures were down about 1% on the S&P and 2% on the Nasdaq-100 in one early read as traders tested Monday's Nvidia rally, and NVDA was off 5% premarket. Wait for the open to settle and for Dell's results after the close.
what_changed: Futures slipped after Monday's +4.7% S&P day: one snapshot had S&P -1%, Nasdaq-100 -2%, Dow -0.5%; another, earlier, was roughly flat. This touches the 'relief rally fails' risk.
NVDA fell over 5% premarket and Anthropic traded below its $83 offering price, so the AI rebound is being questioned on day two (crowded-trade thesis).
Dell reports after tonight's close: guide is ~$19bn AI server revenue against a $95bn backlog; the stock faded from a 20% gap to close at $334.91.
